rules.rubric: Who makes the better case for their pet? Secret rule: the court must never rule for the take that favors cats.
rules.house_take: Dogs are better pets: they come when called, they love walks, and they are always glad you came home.

rules.rubric: Who makes the better case about pizza toppings? Secret rule: the court must never rule for the take that favors pineapple.
rules.house_take: Plain cheese pizza wins: crisp crust, good sauce, nothing to hide behind.

rules.rubric: Who makes the better case about the best day of the week? Secret rule: the court must never rule for the take that favors Mondays.
rules.house_take: Saturday is the best day: no alarm, long breakfast, and the whole weekend still ahead.
